C9000293.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 293 (Invariant projections, hyperinvariant subspaces, and transitive algebras.; papers: Invariant-projection counterexamples for every irrational rotation; Backward intertwiners and a transitive commutant; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/293.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_QSS_SUPPORT.statement: The literal complex weighted-bounded support-separation assertion eq:p3-support-separation under every hypothesis of lem:domar.
